notes.title: Just In Time For Halloween, Spooky Mystery Whodunit Is Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/bfafed816a6a7903571576b1dcf456bb986b04af.png[/img]

[b]Put your detective hat on and solve the untimely murder of a famous video game designer.[/b]

A fabulously wealthy game designer is found dead outside his castle in rural Vermont, and soon evidence shows that this was not merely a freak accident attributed to local superstition. Now it's up to you to investigate the murder and apprehend the guilty. Play as unlikely partners -- ace sleuth Detective Guy and Cleo, the clue-sniffing dog to explore the castle grounds, search for clues, and question suspects. Can you solve the case?
[list]
[*] Murder mystery whodunit
[*] Play as a detective and dog crime-solving team
[*] Explore the area and look for clues
[*] Interview suspects and make deductions
[*] Solve the case and apprehend the guilty
[/list]
“I’m excited to share “Murder Is Game Over” with gamers and mystery fans everywhere. I hope players enjoy the exploration mechanics, spooky atmosphere, and classically-inspired whodunit story,” said Matthew of HitherYon Games. 

[b]Murder Is Game Over[/b] is 20% off until November 1. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940090/Murder_Is_Game_Over

notes.title: Meridian4 News - Paladin Dream Black Friday / Holiday Season Game Update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/3e421082f02e384b8866abfb6791154835d79fae.gif[/img]

It’s been really enjoyable and inspirational to watch players stream Paladin Dream. It feels like playing God and watching people explore the world I created, and I also get to see which parts are celebrated, and where the game could be better or less confusing. I’ve gotten lots of positive feedback about the story, and I wanted to focus this update on showing more information about the world.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/68383540a8f4929bdc3e0e8b334b9fa0d5874187.jpg[/img]

The demon worshiping cult is malicious, reclusive, and possesses black magic to keep outsiders away. I wanted to show the extent to which they’ve gone to protect their temple (which was crudely dug out of a city wall). In the update, Josiah explores an MC Escher-like looping room and a hallucination that projects his fear. This dungeon is intended to be full of creepy traps. The fortune-teller in Nazarfang encounter is also expanded a bit, to give the player some early insight into the 3 different religions and how they interact.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/ee311ab4446d59c7fb1787b30db4574ce13d5b02.png[/img]

The northern wilderness is an area that is mostly not settled, and wild animals have free reign. Organized religion does not have much influence here. I created a new encounter where Josiah spars with another adventurer and their wild animal companion. There’s also a new battle with Josiah’s Reflection (think Link’s Shadow in Zelda games) that requires a bit of logic to win. To ease a side quest that involves a decent amount of backtracking, and I added a way for Josiah to jump down the mountain with a certain item. Making it to the top of Starcross Peak requires Josiah to leave civilization behind and examine his beliefs from a different perspective.

I fixed some minor bugs including dialog, art, and game balance. When you reach a new level, there is also a new common event that fires to tell the player to check and see if they’ve learned a new spell. Hopefully, this will lead to players realizing there are multiple ways to manage their resources. It’s great to get feedback and continue expanding the game.

Hope everyone has a wonderful holiday season and thanks for supporting Paladin Dream!

Matthew

p.s. If you've read this far and haven't yet added Paladin Dream to your wishlist, now is your chance :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592120/Paladin_Dream/

notes.title: Meridian4 News - The Dark Prophecy Game Update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/c0e5deda1c0f61c1b7df2dd7ba749478d5f4cfbb.gif[/img]

Can you hear the trumpets and the stomping of horses? It seems we are approaching the royal castle! This location is an important link in Jacob's journey to other places. And, as you can see for yourself - from here we have a way to the kitchen, to the servants' room, to the king's castle, and to the prison (and who knows which location we will find ourselves in next time!).

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/c28150d01fd200af971c60bb58d0c9934ae9d72c.png[/img]

Here, for the first time, we meet the inhabitants of the castle - a bored and resting servant, a castle keeper, and a guard patrolling the wall.

At the moment, this location, like the previous "Castle Gates", is being added with minimal functionality.

The plan is to add all the planned content first, and only then polish the game and fill it with all the dialogue, adventure, and puzzles you need.

Sorry for the slow development speed - the artist and I are doing our best to release the game as soon as possible. And, although after the main work we only have evenings and weekends to work on the project, we will slowly but surely bring it to a happy end.

Thanks to everyone who continues to follow the project - you give us the strength to continue. Stay tuned! See you in the next updates!

Thanks for all your support!
Dennis

p.s. If you're reading this and still have not added The Dark Prophecy to your wishlist, now is your chance ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1565680/The_Dark_Prophecy/

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.2.0 - New Feature, Challenge Levels
notes.content:
The Wizard and The Slug has been updated to version 1.2.0 based on your feedback and suggestions. We've added a new feature, Challenge Levels! 

⚠️ WARNING ⚠️ These are very challenging levels for hardcore platformer players. They are difficult and require a mastery of the mechanics to beat. 

🛠️ Changelog 🛠️
-------------------
- New Feature: challenge levels (5 levels)
- Minor balancing changes
- Screenshake now toggleable in options
- 2 new achievements added for challenge mode

Keep the suggestions flowing as we consider what to add next to the game.

If you haven't do so yet, please consider adding a Steam review. ⭐ 🙏

Thank you all for your continued support!

Robin, Silkworm Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271170/The_Wizard_and_The_Slug/

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.1.0 - New Feature, Boss Rush
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37911871/67d1c6a9cbbaa333e90c56b5864010ff690aa175.gif[/img]

Today we've launched our third update (version 1.1.0) based on your feedback and suggestions, and it's a big one.

Boss Rush is live!

You will battle with unique bosses one after another. Defeat them all. Each boss has different attack patterns, unique skills and powers!

Thank you all for your continued support and feedback. Keep the suggestions flowing as we consider what to add to the game next.

If you haven't do so yet, please consider adding a Steam review.

Happy gaming!
Robin, Silkworm Games
